jobs.description: Company description:At NKT in Karlskrona, we develop and manufacture high voltage power cables that enable the transition to renewable energy. At Sandvik Rock Tools in Sandviken, we're exploring how industrial sensor data can provide earlier and more reliable insight into machine conditions. This thesis combines practical measurements on production equipment with signal processing, data analysis, and AI to establish a reusable approach for future condition-monitoring initiatives. Background and purpose Modern production equipment generates many signals, but existing machine data is not always reliable or sampled at the frequency required for condition assessment. Additional sensors may be needed to capture vibration, temperature, acoustic, electrical, pressure, or other process-related phenomena.  The purpose of this thesis is to evaluate suitable sensors and data-collection methods, then analyze data from selected equipment using statistical and AI-based methods. The result should support further development of condition monitoring, diagnostics, and data-driven maintenance at Rock Tools. Work description The thesis is carried out as a structured proof of concept. Together with the company supervisor, you refine the scope, machine case, and success criteria. The work is expected to include:     Review relevant research on industrial condition monitoring, sensor selection, signal processing, and AI methods.     Define machine states, operating conditions, potential failure modes, and evaluation criteria.     Evaluate sensors and data-acquisition solutions based on sampling rate, installation, synchronization, robustness, accessibility and cost.     Plan and perform data collection, documenting sensor placement, machine settings and data quality.     Clean, synchronize and analyze time-series data using suitable time, frequency or time-frequency features.     Develop and compare statistical baselines and AI models for classification or anomaly detection.     Validate performance, including false alarms, missed detections, changing operating conditions, explainability and uncertainty.     Recommend sensors, an architecture aligned with the Sandvik Rock Tools Unified Namespace, a modelling approach and next steps. Expected deliverables are a sensor and data-acquisition concept, a quality-checked dataset, reproducible analysis and model code, a comparison of methods and a roadmap for continued development. The objective is a robust proof of concept and reusable method, not a production-ready predictive-maintenance platform.   Your profile We're looking for one or two analytical and hands-on students with an interest in industrial equipment, measurement technology, and data science. You work systematically, document decisions, and connect model results to physical machine behavior. Your background includes:     Ongoing Master’s studies in automation, mechatronics, mechanical or electrical engineering, engineering physics, computer science, industrial data science or a related field.     Experience with Python and data analysis.      An understanding of, or motivation to learn, time-series analysis, signal processing, machine learning and experimental design.       Good communication skills in English; Swedish is advantageous.  Experience with vibration analysis, industrial sensors, OPC UA, MQTT, PLC/CNC data or condition monitoring is advantageous, as is Knowledge of NumPy, pandas, SciPy, scikit-learn, PyTorch or TensorFlow. Our culture At Sandvik, we work with advanced technology and exciting innovations, but our people are the key to our success. We believe diversity and inclusion create stronger results through mutual support, knowledge sharing and different perspectives. Visit our stories hub, LinkedIn or Facebook to get to know us further.  Scope The thesis corresponds to 30 ECTS credits and approximately 20 weeks of full-time work. The start date is agreed with the selected student or students and the university.  The position is based at Rock Tools in Sandviken, Sweden, with access to relevant equipment, data and supervision. Confidentiality, data handling and publication boundaries will be agreed at the start of the project. Contact information For more information, please contact Andreas Nelson, Method Development, at Tools, andreas.nelson@sandvik.comWe’ve already decided on which advertising channels and marketing campaigns we wish to use and respectfully decline any additional contacts in that matter. Application Please submit your application by December 13, 2026. Attach your CV, cover letter and transcript of records. Describe your experience with sensor data, signal processing, machine learning or industrial equipment, and what interests you most about the project. Applications by email are not accepted. Job ID: R0099692. Sandvik is a global, high-tech engineering group providing solutions that enhance productivity, profitability and sustainability in the manufacturing, mining and infrastructure industries. Our offering includes equipment, tools, services and digital solutions for machining, mining, rock excavation, crushing and screening.

Research shows that women and other under-represented groups within our industry hesitate to apply unless they tick most boxes of a role description. At Stegra, we are building an impact company with sustainability at its core. We need a diverse, inclusive, and authentic team to rally behind our purpose of de-carbonizing hard-to-abate industries, starting with steel.So, if you are equally passionate about our purpose yet concerned that your experience doesn’t perfectly align with the qualifications stated in the job advert, we strongly encourage you to apply anyway. You may be just the right candidate, either for this role – or for another upcoming role in our rapidly growing business.About us:Stegra is on a mission to disrupt the global steel industry by producing green steel, with the end goal of bringing down CO2 emissions to zero. By using green hydrogen and fossil-free electricity instead of coal; water and heat will be our primary emissions. By 2030, our ambition is to produce 5 million tonnes of green steel annually in our fully integrated, digitalized, and sustainable plant in Boden, located in northern Sweden - currently in construction phase. But this is just the beginning – our expertise in green hydrogen will enable us to decarbonize other industries in addition to steel, and we look forward to what’s next in store for us.We are looking for talented, innovative, and purpose-driven people to join our rapidly growing and diverse team. Our employees get to learn everyday, implement the latest technology and test and put their ideas into practice. Together, we are building an impact company with sustainability at its core – for our people, customers, investors, society, and planet.Work location: BodenWhat you’ll doRight now, we are looking for a Project Engineer for our Project Delivery team. In this role you will work closely with our Groundworks Manager, Construction teams, EPCM Area Leads, planners, and contractors to support the delivery of civil and early works across the Boden project.As Project Engineer, you will help turn engineering packages into construction-ready scopes. You will coordinate documentation, interfaces, and execution requirements to ensure workfronts are properly prepared before being released to contractors. This is a hands-on role suited to someone who enjoys working close to both engineering and site execution.Specific to this role, the day-to-day tasks will include the following but as we are a growing company with very little silos between teams, other tasks might be included as well.    Coordinate preparation and release of groundworks scopes, ensuring drawings, quantities, and execution requirements are ready for construction    Maintain the Groundworks Scope Tracker and consolidate inputs from EPCM partners, design teams, and planners    Support forecasting and planning of upcoming groundworks activities    Coordinate scope clarifications between Engineering, Planning, Construction, and contractors    Support and maintain a structured RFI process between contractors and engineering stakeholders    Help align groundworks activities with project schedules, civil milestones, and interface dependencies    Participate in coordination meetings and support progress reporting and issue resolution    Monitor contractor readiness, access conditions, and documentation prior to site executionWhat you’ll bringYou’re curious and believe that real progress happens when we work together. You’re not afraid to challenge old ways of thinking and you treat others with respect while doing it. At Stegra, we value people who take initiative, build trust, and help create a workplace where everyone can do their best.This role is well suited to someone who has built a solid foundation in civil engineering or construction and wants to continue developing in a large-scale industrial project environment.Specific to this role, we would like to see that you can tick off a fair amount of the boxes below    Degree in Civil Engineering, Construction Management, or a related technical field    Around 3–7 years of experience from large-scale industrial, construction, or infrastructure projects    Good understanding of civil construction, design documentation, and site execution    Experience working in EPCM, contractor, or major project environments is considered an advantage    Strong coordination skills and the ability to work across multiple teams and disciplines    Familiarity with Primavera P6 or similar planning tools is considered an advantage    Experience with Swedish AMA/AB04 standards is considered a plus    Fluency in English; Swedish is considered an advantage
